thread.title: Higher Open Called For Indonesia Stock

author: rttnews.com
title: Higher Open Called For Indonesia Stock
text:
The Indonesia stock market on Wednesday halted the two-day slide in which it had stumbled almost 50 points or 0.8 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now rests just beneath the 6,465-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green again on Thursday.
The global forecast for the Asian markets is broadly positive on an improved outlook for interest rates and a spike in crude oil prices. The European and U.S. markets were up and the Asian bourses are predicted to follow suit.
The JCI finished modestly higher on Wednesday following mixed performances from the financial shares and the resource stocks.
For the day, the index advanced 27.71 points or 0.43 percent to finish at 6,464.19 after trading between 6,435.42 and 6,464.93.
Among the actives, Indocement plunged 4.01 percent, while Semen Indonesia skidded 2.52 percent, United Tractors advanced 0.97 percent, Unilever Indonesia spiked 3.10 percent, Holcim Indonesia added 0.26 percent, Bank Central Asia shed 0.36 percent, Bank Mandiri jumped 1.75 percent, Bank Negara Indonesia lost 0.28 percent, Bank Rakyat Indonesia collected 1.63 percent, Bumi Resources plummeted 3.59 percent, Aneka Tambang rose 3.26 percent, Vale Indonesia surged 5.08 percent and Indosat, Bank Danamon Indonesia and Indofood Suskes were unchanged.
The lead from Wall Street is firm in response to the Federal Reserve's monetary policy announcement, which sent the major averages to nearly two-month closing highs.
The Dow added 434.90 points or 1.77 percent to 25,014.86, while the NASDAQ surged 154.79 points or 2.20 rose 41.05 points or 1.55 percent to 2,681.05.
Stocks accelerated to the upside after the Fed
Positive sentiment was also generated by solid earnings news from (BA) and Apple (AAPL).
